Use case: stylized-concept. Production HEAD portrait for the native Slay the Spire 2 boss MAP icon. The mod-owned reference image is the character identity reference and old map-art target. Redesign with a tighter focus on the crowned gray rat king's long muzzle, incisors, round ears, spiked crown and a very short shoulder cloak. Keep recognisable menacing mischievous grin. An expressive hand-inked storybook creature head: irregular confident pen contours, restrained hatching, broad shadow shapes with transparent internal cutouts. A single dark brown ink color, absolutely no grey shading, gradients, green, glow, frame or text. Real transparent alpha background. Square canvas1254x1254; COMPLETE crown, ears, fur and muzzle contained within central80% with equal visible safe margins on ALL sides. No throne spikes extending into margins, no torso below upper shoulders. This will be tinted by the game's native map colors at approx300px. Head silhouette must be legible. Do not draw an esports logo.
